# Service bulletin AL-SB-2026-042: fault code E-42 on AL-300 and AL-320B lifts

Fault code
:   E-42

Meaning
:   Drive inverter overcurrent trip: the drive protected itself and the car is locked out of service until it is inspected.

Expected recovery
:   90 minutes (typical time for a technician to attend, inspect the drive and reset it)

Manual reset required
:   yes

Affected versions
:   AL-300, AL-320B, controller firmware 4.2, 4.3

## Details

The car does not return to service by itself. Call Ascendia service; a qualified technician must inspect the drive before the reset. Plan for the lift to be unavailable for the rest of the shift if a replacement part is needed.
